methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $46.94B (to $70.45B) × margin 8.1% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $42.82B
K = capital to build it: $46.94B ÷ sales-to-capital 0.95 = $49.30B
σ = 32% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $13.48B
assets in place = NOPAT $1.63B ÷ WACC = $22.94B; value = ($22.94B + $13.48B − net debt $12.91B) ÷ 463,800,000 = $50.70
